manager.stil.offen.text: The squad does not know you well enough to place you yet. Your behaviour in talks paints a picture.
manager.stil.hart.text: You say clearly what you want and tolerate little dissent. That earns respect and sometimes headwind.
manager.stil.fuersorglich.text: You listen, ask questions and take the people behind the players seriously. That builds trust but costs firmness.
manager.stil.diplomatisch.text: You weigh things up, look for balance and keep doors open. That brings calm but can look hesitant.
manager.stil.kumpelhaft.text: You are relaxed, joke with the dressing room and stay at eye level. That makes you popular but costs authority.
manager.kasse.unter: Your salary lands here; courses, leisure and housing are paid from it.
manager.zustand.energie.unter: Whoever is drained makes poorer decisions.
manager.zustand.stress.unter: The job wears you down every week. Leisure and a good home ease the pressure.
manager.zustand.treue.unter: Whoever keeps promises is called reliable. The dressing room does not forget broken ones.
manager.zustand.motivation.unter: With some distance and joy in the job, a lot goes easier.
manager.wert.menschenfuehrung.unter: Kind words land harder on morale and relationships.
manager.wert.taktikwissen.unter: Whoever understands more plans better against the opponent.
manager.wert.autoritaet.unter: Harsh words cost you less backing.
manager.wert.medienwirkung.unter: Your performance before press and fans counts for more.
manager.wert.nachwuchsarbeit.unter: Young players find their way more easily.
manager.wert.fitnesswissen.unter: You plan load and recovery more wisely.
manager.wert.verhandlungsgeschick.unter: Negotiations tend to go your way.
manager.wert.motivation.unter: With joy in the job you carry the squad with you.
manager.wert.ruf.unter: Your name carries weight with the board. Your private life gets around too.
manager.passung.neutral: He has not formed a firm picture of you yet.
manager.passung.minus.hart: He finds your tone too harsh.
manager.passung.plus.fuersorglich: He feels looked after with you.
manager.passung.minus.fuersorglich: He wants more demands and less care from you.
manager.passung.plus.diplomatisch: He always finds an open ear with you.
manager.passung.minus.diplomatisch: He thinks you are too cautious and wants a clear line.
manager.passung.plus.kumpelhaft: He gets along well with you.
manager.passung.minus.kumpelhaft: He does not quite take you seriously, you are too casual for him.
manager.liste.passung: How the squad gets on with you
manager.leer.buchungen: No spending yet. The salary arrives at the end of the month.
manager.leer.seite: Soon this shows how you are doing. Once the season is under way your profile fills up.
manager.lehrgang.lizenz_b.text: The basics of the job: training, game idea, leadership.
manager.lehrgang.lizenz_a.text: For higher leagues: deeper tactics and more weight in the dressing room.
manager.lehrgang.lizenz_pro.text: The top level that clubs respect.
manager.lehrgang.taktikseminar.text: A week on pressing, transitions and use of space.
manager.lehrgang.sportpsychologie.text: How people think under pressure and how to lead them.
manager.lehrgang.medientraining.text: Stay calm in front of the camera and land the message.
manager.lehrgang.jugendarbeit.text: Develop young players and bring parents, school and club together.
manager.lehrgang.verhandlungsseminar.tex: Leading talks at the table with agents and clubs.
manager.fx.welt.vorstandsvertrauen: The board gets to know you better
manager.freizeit.golf.text: A round with people from the club's circle. Contacts happen on the side.
manager.ok.freizeit.golf: You played a round of golf and people saw you.
manager.freizeit.tennis.text: A tough match without a tactics board. Afterwards you are tired and content.
manager.ok.freizeit.tennis: You played a tough match and feel free.
manager.freizeit.urlaub.text: A whole week away from everything. Only during a break in fixtures.
manager.ok.freizeit.urlaub: You went away. The week was yours.
manager.freizeit.hobby.text: Something that has nothing to do with football.
manager.ok.freizeit.hobby: You made time for your hobby.
manager.freizeit.familie.text: An evening at the dinner table without a phone.
manager.ok.freizeit.familie: You spent time with your family.
manager.freizeit.freunde.text: Old friends who do not ask about the line-up.
manager.ok.freizeit.freunde: You met old friends and laughed a lot.
manager.freizeit.dinner.text: An evening with the partner's guests.
manager.ok.freizeit.dinner: You attended the sponsor's dinner and it was a good evening.
manager.freizeit.golf_einladung.text: A round with the board by invitation.
manager.ok.freizeit.golf_einladung: You played golf with the board and the ice is broken.
manager.grund.spielzeit: Only in a break from fixtures
manager.grund.kasse: Your private account does not cover it
manager.woche.plaetze.unter: That is how much time you have for yourself this week.
manager.haus.wohnung.text: Small, central, no garden. Good enough to sleep in.
manager.haus.haus_miete.text: Room for the family and a garden for the dog.
manager.haus.haus_kauf.text: A house that is yours. It roots you in the city.
manager.haus.villa.text: Peace behind tall hedges. You recover especially well there.
manager.ok.lehrgang: The course is booked. You will find it in the calendar.
manager.ok.haus: You have moved. The boxes are unpacked.
manager.fehler.eingabe: That did not work out. Try again.
manager.fehler.lehrgang_fertig: You have already completed this course.
manager.fehler.lehrgang_laeuft: You already booked a course. The next one comes when it is over.
manager.fehler.lehrgang_vorher: You are still missing the level before it.
manager.fehler.kasse: Your private account does not cover that.
manager.fehler.einladung: You need an invitation for that.
manager.fehler.spielzeit: There is no time for that in the middle of the season. Wait for a week without fixtures.
manager.fehler.pause: You only just did that. Let a few days pass.
manager.fehler.zeit: No evening is left this week.
wartet.manager.1: The secretary's office checks your appointments …
manager.passung.zeile: How does he get on with you?
manager.passung.plus.typ.hitzig: His temper fizzles out around you; at eye level and with humour he cools down fast.
manager.passung.minus.typ.hitzig: He flares up as soon as you raise your voice, and the two of you fire each other up.
manager.passung.neutral.typ.hitzig: He takes you as you come, as long as you stay calm.
manager.passung.plus.typ.loyal: He stays true to you because you take him seriously.
manager.passung.minus.typ.loyal: He feels unseen by you and withdraws.
manager.passung.neutral.typ.loyal: He stays loyal to you without making a fuss.
manager.passung.plus.typ.ehrgeizig: He seeks friction with you and grows on it; your clear line challenges him.
manager.passung.minus.typ.ehrgeizig: He wants more demands from you and takes leniency for standing still.
manager.passung.neutral.typ.ehrgeizig: He judges you by results, not by tone.
manager.passung.plus.typ.sensibel: He feels looked after by you and dares to make mistakes.
manager.passung.minus.typ.sensibel: He takes every harsh word home and broods over it.
manager.passung.neutral.typ.sensibel: He pays close attention to how you say things.
manager.passung.plus.typ.gelassen: He takes your ways with a smile and keeps working calmly.
manager.passung.minus.typ.gelassen: Neither your pressure nor your encouragement reaches him; he just shrugs.
manager.passung.plus.typ.wechselfreudig: He feels comfortable enough with you to put his thoughts of leaving on hold.
manager.passung.minus.typ.wechselfreudig: Your tone gives him one more reason to look around for another club.
manager.passung.neutral.typ.wechselfreud: He keeps his options open, however you come across.
manager.passung.plus.typ.launisch: Your reliability absorbs his mood swings.
manager.passung.minus.typ.launisch: His moods and your style feed off each other.
manager.passung.neutral.typ.launisch: Some days he gets along with you, other days he does not.
manager.passung.plus.typ.neutral: He gets along well with you and has nothing to complain about.
manager.passung.minus.typ.neutral: He cannot do much with your style.
manager.passung.neutral.typ.neutral: He has no firm opinion about your style.
